Container.Name: Cruncharr
Container.Overview: Cruncharr is a self-hosted companion for keeping your personal anime media library organized. It gives you a clean, *arr-style web interface with catalog and library tracking, a release calendar, activity history, and Sonarr integration so everything lines up with the collection you already manage. Multi-architecture image (amd64 and arm64). Set PUID/PGID to match the owner of your appdata and media shares so the container can write to them.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: anime media library catalog sonarr arr
Container.Requires: Internet access and an account with your source service. Some sources may require the matching device files to be placed in the /widevine path.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Cruncharr web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores settings, catalog, activity history and logs.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Where your library files are written and organized.

Config.Name: Device Files
Config.Description: Optional path for source device files, if your source requires them.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Match the owner of your config and media shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as.

Config.Name: API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: require this key to access the interface. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Account Email (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pre-fill your source account email. Can also be set in the web interface.

Config.Name: Account Password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pre-fill your source account password. Can also be set in the web interface.
